title: Two Delegations, One Week
description: Both the Stellamere and Orythian delegations have formally requested meetings this week. Vyktor's read is unambiguous: visiting both capitals within a month makes both offers worse. One door opens. The other stays closed — perhaps permanently.

title: Visit Stellamere — Federal Hall
description: Ambassador Cole has offered a tour of Federal Hall and a meeting with the Arcturian Trade Commission. The offer includes a joint statement on 'democratic governance and economic partnership.' The Arcturians are selling stability.

title: Visit Petravar — Ministry of Fraternal Relations
description: Commissar Stahl greets inside — security over salesmanship. The offer is 'fraternal solidarity': military coordination, resource guarantees, ideological partnership. The Orythians are selling protection.

title: Constitutional Draft — Final Language
description: With the foreign alignment decision crystallizing, the constitutional language on international treaties and military alliances takes on new weight. The draft's foreign relations article needs final review.

title: Budget Allocation — Foreign Alignment Impact
description: Whichever superpower you align with, the budget will need restructuring. Arcturian alignment means trade liberalization. Orythian alignment means military investment. Both have price tags.

title: Nadia Voss — Interview Response
description: Voss is waiting for an answer on her records request. The fourteen-day clock is running. She's also requested an interview — on the record, no publication conditions. Vyktor says ignoring her is the one strategy guaranteed to backfire.

title: The Megaproject Dilemma
description: Minister Varro is ready to present the three infrastructure proposals. One budget. One decision.
